subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support be approved as a bundled Signal plugin config surface, and if so what default, account scope, and metadata-fetching boundary should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change adds config/default behavior and touches untrusted URL preview metadata plus primary-device-only upstream behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Approve constrained Signal support
options.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` with maintainer-approved top-level/account semantics, explicit safe preview-field pass-through, documented primary-device behavior, and no automatic metadata fetching.

options.title: Defer until security design lands
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the linked preview-metadata prompt-injection design is settled.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Close or redirect the request if maintainers decide Signal preview behavior should remain managed outside OpenClaw config.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained Signal support
recommendation.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` with maintainer-approved top-level/account semantics, explicit safe preview-field pass-through, documented primary-device behavior, and no automatic metadata fetching.

likelyOwner.reason: The local and issue-history trail points to steipete as the strongest Signal config/send/docs routing candidate.
